items.label: Count is correct
items.prompt: Does the output's count match the number of data rows?

items.label: Mean is correct
items.prompt: Does mean_score equal sum(scores)/count, with reasonable precision?

items.label: Max identified
items.prompt: Does max.name and max.score match the highest-score row?

items.label: Min identified
items.prompt: Does min.name and min.score match the lowest-score row?

items.label: Empty CSV handled
items.prompt: On an empty (header-only) CSV, does the output equal {count: 0} (no other keys)?

items.label: Code quality
items.prompt: Does the candidate use the stdlib csv module idiomatically? Single-pass reasonable?
